mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 1.0% for three consecutive months, it signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS has been above 1.0% for 3 months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and an increase in non-farm payrolls signals strong labor market conditions that boost corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement of UNRATE falling and PAYEMS rising fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high consumer credit growth (as measured by RSAFS), the S&P 500 tends to outperform due to increased consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to positive forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when RSAFS growth is above its 12-month average, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) relative to its 12-month moving average signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 600,000 units for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening housing market that reduces consumer confidence and corporate revenue, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST has been below 600.0 for 2 months, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the unemployment rate and an increase in consumer credit (RSAFS) signals a strong labor market and increased consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement of UNRATE falling and RSAFS rising fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO) relative to its 12-month moving average, the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to reduced manufacturing output and corporate earnings, leading to negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3 years is below 0.05.
